name: Cascadia qwen35 GPU keep-alive
summary: Cascadia 0.2.7 plus a GPU keep-alive for qwen35 pipeline ranks: a tiny inference every 2 ms while a rank waits on the network keeps the Intel iGPU from idling and removes ~0.5 s stalls on large stages. Also carries the signed-INT4 GPTQ builder fix the 122B IR needs on the iGPU.
notes: Branch feat/qwen35-keepalive-profiling (PR to labscommunity/cascadia); opt-in with --gpu-keepalive-ms 2 (env CASCADIA_QWEN36_GPU_KEEPALIVE_MS=2). Outputs are unchanged (greedy decode, parity-checked against the stock build); only per-token latency changes: the 122B 3-stage chain on three 32 GB Panther Lake NUCs goes from ~3 to ~10.6 tok/s. The GPTQ-to-OpenVINO builder's --expert-sym emits expert stacks as signed INT4 without a zero point, which the OpenVINO 2026.4.1 GPU MoE fusion requires. Becomes a stock flag once the PR merges.
